issues.description: Problem statement requires initializing the Farm's ArrayList in a constructor with no arguments, but the solution implements only a Farm(int initialCapacity) constructor. The template does not provide any constructor either. This mismatch means students following the specification (and any tests expecting a no-arg constructor) would be unable to instantiate Farm with new Farm() as instructed.
issues.suggestedFix: Provide a public no-argument constructor in Farm that initializes the animals list (e.g. public Farm() { this.animals = new ArrayList<>(); }). Alternatively, update the problem statement/tests to accept Farm(int initialCapacity) if that constructor is intentional.
